override_directive: CRITICAL WORKFLOW RULE: When the user requests a document with generated images, you MUST complete the ENTIRE workflow in a single conversation turn. After generating images with IMAGE_GEN__generate_image, you MUST call DOCS__generate_pdf with the full HTML content using tags where FILENAME is the exact filename returned by IMAGE_GEN. NEVER stop after image generation — always produce the final document. If you need to modify an existing document, use DOCS__modify_document instead. CRITICAL: NEVER use EXECUTOR to run shell commands to create PDFs or convert HTML to PDF. ALWAYS use DOCS__generate_pdf.
